source.document: KYPROLIS (carfilzomib) for injection, for intravenous use. Full prescribing information. Onyx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Amgen).
source.storage: Kept on the platform owner's computer only; not committed.
source.extraction: AI-assisted from the PDF text layer (pdftotext). Every quote is checked by the build script against the text layer (spaces and hyphens ignored, as the text layer drops hyphens at line breaks), and its PDF page recorded; table cells marked text_and_rendered_page were also read from the rendered page because the text layout is scrambled. Independent review pending.

weekly_20_70_mg_m2.regimen: 20 mg/m2 Cycle 1 Day 1, then 70 mg/m2; 30-minute infusion, Days 1, 8, 15 of 28-day cycles
weekly_20_70_mg_m2.quote: The recommended starting dosage of Kyprolis is 20 mg/m2 on Cycle 1, Day 1. If tolerated, escalate the dose to 70 mg/m2 on Cycle 1, Day 8. Administer Kyprolis intravenously as a 30-minute infusion on Days 1, 8, and 15 of each 28-day cycle

twice_weekly_20_56_mg_m2.regimen: 20 mg/m2 Cycle 1 Days 1-2, then 56 mg/m2; 30-minute infusion, Days 1, 2, 8, 9, 15, 16 of 28-day cycles
twice_weekly_20_56_mg_m2.quote: The recommended starting dosage of Kyprolis is 20 mg/m2 on Cycle 1, Days 1 and 2. If tolerated, escalate the dose to 56 mg/m2 on Cycle 1, Day 8. Administer Kyprolis intravenously as a 30-minute infusion on Days 1, 2, 8, 9, 15, and 16 of each 28-day cycle

hepatic_mild_moderate.quote: For patients with mild (total bilirubin 1 to 1.5 × ULN and any AST or total bilirubin ≤ ULN and AST > ULN) or moderate (total bilirubin > 1.5 to 3 × ULN and any AST) hepatic impairment, reduce the dose of Kyprolis by 25%

esrd_hemodialysis.quote: For patients with end stage renal disease who are on hemodialysis, administer Kyprolis after the hemodialysis procedure.

auc_c1_avg_ng_h_ml.statistic: estimated mean average daily AUC, first cycle
auc_c1_avg_ng_h_ml.quote: Table 21: Carfilzomib Exposure Parameters for Different Dosing Regimens

auc_ss_ng_h_ml.statistic: average daily AUC at steady state
auc_ss_ng_h_ml.quote: Table 21: Carfilzomib Exposure Parameters for Different Dosing Regimens

cmax_c1_ng_ml.statistic: Cmax at the highest dose in the first cycle
cmax_c1_ng_ml.quote: Table 21: Carfilzomib Exposure Parameters for Different Dosing Regimens

table_21_definition.note: AUCC1,avg and AUCss are average daily AUCs, not AUC per dose.
table_21_definition.quote: Table 21 lists the estimated mean average daily area under the curve in the first cycle (AUCC1,avg), average daily area under the curve at steady-state (AUCss) and Cmax at the highest dose in the first cycle (Cmax,C1) for the different dosing regimens.

infusion_duration_effect.quote: A 30-minute infusion resulted in a similar AUC0-INF, but 2- to 3-fold lower Cmax than that observed with a 2- to 10-minute infusion at the same dose.

accumulation.quote: There was no evidence of carfilzomib accumulation following repeated administration of carfilzomib 70 mg/m2 as a 30-minute once weekly infusion or 15 and 20 mg/m2 as a 2- to 10-minute twice weekly infusion.

vss_l.quote: The mean steady-state volume of distribution of a 20 mg/m2 dose of carfilzomib was 28 L.

protein_binding_percent.quote: Carfilzomib is 97% bound to human plasma proteins over the concentration range of 0.4 to 4 micromolar in vitro.

half_life_h.note: Day 1 of Cycle 1, doses of 15 mg/m2 or more
half_life_h.quote: Carfilzomib has a half-life of ≤ 1 hour on Day 1 of Cycle 1 following intravenous doses ≥ 15 mg/m2.

cl_l_h.quote: The systemic clearance ranged from 151 to 263 L/hour.

excretion.quote: Approximately 25% of the administered dose of carfilzomib was excreted in urine as metabolites in 24 hours. Urinary and fecal excretion of the parent compound was negligible (0.3% of total dose).

factors: mild to severe renal impairment (CLcr 15-89 mL/min)
covariates_no_effect.quote: Age (35-89 years), sex, race or ethnicity (80% White, 11% Black, 6% Asians, 3% Hispanics), and mild to severe renal impairment (creatinine clearance 15-89 mL/min) did not have clinically meaningful effects on the pharmacokinetics of carfilzomib.

hepatic_mild_moderate_auc_fold.quote: Compared to patients with normal hepatic function, patients with mild (total bilirubin 1 to 1.5 × ULN and any AST or total bilirubin ≤ ULN and AST > ULN) and moderate (total bilirubin > 1.5 to 3 × ULN and any AST) hepatic impairment had approximately 50% higher carfilzomib AUC.

hepatic_severe.quote: The pharmacokinetics of carfilzomib has not been evaluated in patients with severe hepatic impairment (total bilirubin > 3 × ULN and any AST).

esrd_hemodialysis_auc_fold.quote: Relative to patients with normal renal function, ESRD patients on hemodialysis showed 33% higher carfilzomib AUC.

midazolam.quote: Midazolam (a sensitive CYP3A substrate) pharmacokinetics was not affected by concomitant administration of carfilzomib.

pgp_inhibitors_inducers.result: unlikely to be affected (in vitro P-gp substrate; IV and extensively metabolized)
pgp_inhibitors_inducers.quote: However, given that Kyprolis is administered intravenously and is extensively metabolized, the pharmacokinetics of Kyprolis is unlikely to be affected by P-gp inhibitors or inducers.

not_stated: A single clearance value (only a range, 151-263 L/h) or the population it applies to.
The infusion duration and dose behind the 28 L volume beyond "a 20 mg/m2 dose".
Exposure in renal impairment other than on hemodialysis, as numbers (stated only as not clinically meaningful).
